summary.description: HUNTX is a zero-budget Telegram proxy-config aggregation pipeline: 85 configured MTProto/Bot-API sources plus a Go web scraper feed 16 format handlers; governed builds produce per-route artifacts that are ledger-published to Telegram destinations and auto-delivered by the GatherX bot; CI runs the pipeline every 2h with optional S3-immutable state and GitHub Pages frontend.

nodes.name: huntx CLI entry (console script)
nodes.description: Console entry point installed as the `huntx` script. Parses subcommands (run, bot, clean, reset, prune), injects data-dir/db-path precedence (CLI > env > default), acquires process + session locks, and dispatches to the optimized orchestrator. The hardened entry replaces the legacy _cmd_run and evaluates the run-health gate before exiting.

nodes.name: Config loader (YAML + Pydantic)
nodes.description: Loads configs/config.prod.yaml, recursively expands ${ENV} placeholders, and validates sources/routes/destinations against Pydantic models. SourceConfig gates publication eligibility by trust_state; PublishRoute defines formats, from_sources, destinations and publication tier.

nodes.name: Process lock + session lease
nodes.description: File-based mutual exclusion over runs (data/state/huntx.lock) plus a lease file per Telethon session identity with reaping of stale leases, preventing concurrent pipeline processes from double-ingesting the same source. Applies runtime resilience monkey-patches at import time.

nodes.name: OptimizedHardenedOrchestrator
nodes.description: Deadline-aware, stage-bounded run contract: (1) ingestion with persistent newest-window-first (LIFO) queue, (2) transform, (3) governed build per route in a thread pool, (4) ledgered publish, (5) output export, (6) cleanup/prune. Classifies status completed/partial/failed/timed_out and emits a structured run summary consumed by the health gate and CI.

nodes.name: Run health gate
nodes.description: Structured evaluation of a run summary: fatal reasons (failed/timed_out, zero artifacts, all publishes failed), degraded-success signals, and emitted JSON/health report used by CLI exit codes and CI disposition (completed/degraded/fatal).

nodes.name: IngestionPipeline
nodes.description: Per-source pull loop: iterates connector.list_new(state), batches 100 items, SHA-256 hashes content, saves blobs to the raw store, records seen_files rows, acknowledges the connector, and persists cursor state to source_state.

nodes.name: WindowedIngestionPipeline
nodes.description: Persists one MTProto time-window page and its continuation cursor in a single SQLite transaction. Reuses one Telethon connector across pages sharing credentials; rotates only the peer. Runs under a lease claimed from the persistent ingestion queue.
interfaces: run_page(source, item, owner, deadline, page_size) -> dict

nodes.name: Telegram Bot API connector
nodes.description: Ingest connector using the Telegram Bot HTTP API (getUpdates/getFile/download). Stages raw updates into the durable SQLite inbox before acknowledging offsets, filters chat mismatch, media noise, APK/executable and >25MB files, and yields text + document SourceItems.

nodes.name: Telethon MTProto user connector
nodes.description: Ingest connector over Telethon MTProto (user session): two-pass scan (text first, then documents), bounded 25MB streaming downloads, canonical channel resolution for cross-source dedup, flood-wait and reconnect backoff. Windowed variant fetches closed epoch windows with continuation cursors.

nodes.name: V2Ray collector (Go scraper)
nodes.description: Python connector that shells out to a Go scraper (connectors/v2ray_collector/main.go). The Go binary scrapes t.me/s/<channel> web previews, tests TCP reachability of parsed proxies, dedupes, filters Iranian configs, and writes collected_configs.txt which the connector yields as text SourceItems.
interfaces: subprocess: go run main.go (t.me/s scraping, TCP probe)

nodes.name: Telegram Bot API (external)
nodes.description: External HTTPS endpoint https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/*. Used by ingestion for getUpdates/getFile/file download and by publishing for sendDocument multipart uploads. Retry with exponential backoff; 409 Conflict signals a shared token; 429 surfaces bounded retry_after.
interfaces: HTTPS: getUpdates, getFile, file download, sendDocument (api.telegram.org/bot<token>/*)

nodes.name: Telegram MTProto (external)
nodes.description: External MTProto network reached through Telethon user-session (get_entity, iter_messages, iter_download) for ingestion history and through bot-session long polling for the GatherX bot (events.NewMessage / CallbackQuery, send_message, send_file).
interfaces: MTProto: Telethon TelegramClient (user session + bot session long-poll)

nodes.name: t.me channel web previews (external)
nodes.description: Public Telegram channel preview pages (https://t.me/s/<channel>) scraped by the Go v2ray collector with goquery to extract proxy config messages without API credentials.

nodes.name: OptimizedTransformPipeline
nodes.description: Reads pending seen_files in batches of 200, loads raw blobs, resolves format via router.decide_format, runs the registered handler.parse(), and atomically commits records + observation status in one transaction. Bounded by max batches, max records and per-file record caps.

nodes.name: Format handlers (16 registered)
nodes.description: Pluggable FormatHandler protocol registry: npvt, npvtsub, conf_lines, slipnet, ovpn, npv4, ehi, hc, hat, sip, nm, dark, tut, sks, tmt, opaque_bundle. Text handlers parse proxy URI lines; ZIP/opaque handlers wrap stored raw bundles. Build side (re)emits merged artifact bytes.
interfaces: format ids: npvt, npvtsub, conf_lines, slipnet, ovpn, npv4, ehi, hc, hat, sip, nm, dark, tut, sks, tmt, opaque_bundle

nodes.name: GovernedBuildPipeline
nodes.description: Per-route build: fetches records via a verdict-gated query (record_type, source, min_seen_file_id, publication tier, fresh-probe policy), groups by type, invokes each format handler.build() under per-format locks, saves immutable artifacts + outputs, and derives decoded.json / b64sub / singbox.json for npvt-family formats. Single-flight dedup of equivalent concurrent route queries.

nodes.name: PublishPipeline
nodes.description: Ledgered publication: verifies artifact digest, ensures a publication_intents row, and for each destination tracks delivery state (desired/sending/confirmed/failed/unknown_outcome) with receipts. Refuses automatic resend on unknown outcome; completes the intent only when every destination is confirmed; marks published_artifacts.

nodes.name: TelegramPublisher
nodes.description: Sends artifact documents to destination chats via multipart/form-data POST to sendDocument. Implements bounded retry_after handling (HUNTX_PUBLISH_MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS) and classifies transport failures as UnknownPublicationOutcome so the ledger never auto-resends ambiguous deliveries.
interfaces: publish(chat_id, data, filename, caption) -> Telegram response

nodes.name: GatherX InteractiveBot
nodes.description: Persistent Telegram bot (Telethon bot session) with 13 commands, inline keyboards, per-user preferences, admin dashboard, rate limiting, and resumable per-user delivery. Registration is approval-gated via bot_users.approved; delivery writes bot_delivery_items/checkpoint and dedupes by artifact hash.
interfaces: inline callbacks: get:, setfmt:, cmd:, admin:

nodes.name: SelfHealingDaemon
nodes.description: SQLite-backed degradation ledger keyed by proxy unique_hash: records failures, reinstates probes, computes due-for-retest, purges stale nodes, and runs poller cycles. Composed into UnifiedOrchestrator (next-gen variant), not on the production hardened path.

nodes.name: GeoRouting + scoring engines
nodes.description: GeoRoutingEngine infers ISO country codes from proxy URIs (IP/domain heuristics + protocol normalization) and filters by region; ProxyScoringEngine scores records. Composed into UnifiedOrchestrator (next-gen) and exported from the package root; used by huntx-engine georoute.

nodes.name: UnifiedOrchestrator (next-gen)
nodes.description: Experimental successor orchestrator wiring AsyncCircuitBreaker resilience, ProxyScoringEngine, StreamingChunkParser, GeoRoutingEngine, SelfHealingDaemon, OptimizedTransformPipeline, WindowedIngestionPipeline and PersistentIngestionQueue. Exported from package root and covered by tests, but not selected by hardened_main.

nodes.name: SQLite state database
nodes.description: Single SQLite database (data/state/state.db) holding source_state, source_lifecycle, seen_files, records, record_verdicts, published_artifacts, publication_intents/deliveries, telegram_bot_updates/consumers, bot_users, bot_delivery_checkpoint/items, ingestion_campaigns/work_items. WAL mode, synchronous=FULL, busy_timeout 30s, and 10 versioned migrations with postcondition checks.

nodes.name: StateRepo
nodes.description: Data-access facade over the SQLite DB: source offsets, seen_files batch recording, pending-file queries, records batch insert with observation provenance, verdict-aware build query with fan-out dedup, publication ledger operations, and age-based pruning that protects live blob references.

nodes.name: PersistentIngestionQueue (LIFO)
nodes.description: SQLite-backed work queue of closed epoch-aligned time windows per MTProto source. Seeds rolling horizon (lookback HUNTX_LIFO_LOOKBACK_HOURS, window HUNTX_INGEST_WINDOW_SECONDS), claims newest-incomplete windows with leases/uuid tokens, checkpoints continuation cursors, backs off retries with exponential delay, recovers expired leases and quarantines terminal sources.

nodes.name: Lifecycle + verdict stores
nodes.description: Source lifecycle state machine (candidate/approved/degraded/quarantined/retired) with transport/last-valid/publish tracking, plus record verdicts (syntax/probe/policy gates) that govern build eligibility, and Telegram bot-consumer watermarks reconciled against configured tokens.

nodes.name: RawStore (content-addressed)
nodes.description: Immutable blob store keyed by SHA-256 with 2-char sharding under data/raw/. Save/get verify digests; prune_processed and prune_orphans remove blobs only when no active blob-dependent records reference them.

nodes.name: ArtifactStore
nodes.description: Immutable content-addressed internal artifacts (data/dist/internal), user-facing outputs (data/outputs) written atomically only on change, and a timestamped archive (data/archive) pruned on a retention window; list_archive powers bot /latest and /get.

nodes.name: Outputs / dev-outputs export
nodes.description: Writes per-route artifacts into data/outputs (route_format naming, stale-file retention window) and the all-time cumulative proxy set into data/outputs_dev (proxies.txt, proxies.json, proxies_b64sub.txt, _manifest.json) for repository publication by CI.

nodes.name: RejectsStore
nodes.description: Stores rejected observations (source_id, reason, payload) under data/rejects/ for forensic review.

nodes.name: Release manifest (Python + Go)
nodes.description: Builds/verifies a file manifest of release artifacts (sha256, media types, sizes) used by the CLI prune/verify workflow; Go twin (internal/releasemanifest) used by huntx-tools release-manifest.

nodes.name: huntx-engine (Go binary)
nodes.description: Standalone Go CLI (cmd/huntx-engine): parse base64/raw subscription streams into JSON records, high-concurrency TCP/TLS latency benchmark, georoute classify+filter by ISO country, and a self-healing daemon smoke command. Built by CI (go build) and part of the release plane; the production Python pipeline does not invoke it at runtime.

nodes.name: huntx-tools (Go verification CLI)
nodes.description: CI-side Go CLI: runtime-generation build/verify/validate-pointer for immutable state generations, release-manifest build/verify, verify-output (data-dir integrity), and site-data (docs site generation). Enforces SHA-256 manifests, atomic pointer swaps and canonical JSON.

nodes.name: GatherX frontend (GitHub Pages)
nodes.description: Static site served from docs/ (index.html + catalog.json + assets/js) generated by sitegen from verified data-dir outputs; deployed via GitHub Pages and browsed by end users.

nodes.name: AWS S3 immutable state store
nodes.description: Optional durable backend for CI: restores a verified state generation (state.db + raw/outputs/archive payload) keyed by a current.json pointer, and persists each run's checkpoint as an immutable generation with manifest + atomic pointer advance. Skip when S3_BUCKET is unset (stateless runs).

symbols: Upload generation then atomically advance pointer

nodes.name: GitHub Actions CI/CD (huntx.yml)
nodes.description: Zero-budget production orchestrator: cron every 2h + manual dispatch. Jobs: validate (Go+Python quality gates), restore-verified-state (S3), ingest-build-package (runs huntx under a watchdog, verify+package outputs, checkpoint, diagnostics), persist-immutable-state (S3), deploy-pages (GitHub Pages). Plus PR validation, telegram activity gate, real investigation gate and generated-output publication workflows.

symbols: Enforce only truly fatal runtime outcomes

interfaces: workflow_dispatch inputs: max_workers, msg/file fresh/subsequent hours, reset, reset_confirm

edges.description: Parse CLI args, resolve runtime paths, load and validate configs/config.prod.yaml before run.
Acquire data/state/huntx.lock plus per-session lease before orchestrator instantiation.
Construct OptimizedHardenedOrchestrator and run the full pipeline under the lock; also wires GovernedBuildPipeline and consumer reconciliation.
evaluate_run_health(summary) and emit structured health; fatal exits are enforced by the CLI.
Phase 1: asyncio workers pull eligible sources from a queue and call ingest_pipeline.run per source with deadline.
Phase 2: process_pending() drains pending seen_files into records with bounded batches/records.
Phase 3: submit one governed build per route to a ThreadPoolExecutor and wait under the remaining deadline.
Phase 3b: submit publish futures per artifact to a bounded executor unless --no-publish.
list_new(state) iteration for telegram sources (Bot API).
getUpdates (offset/timeout/limit), getFile, and bounded file download from api.telegram.org with exponential retry.
Durable inbox: store raw updates before acknowledging offset; read back updates after local offset.
Content-addressed blob write for each new item; skips existing digests.
Batch-record seen files (source_id, external_id, raw_hash, metadata) and update source_state offsets/stats.
fetch_window_page(window_start/end, continuation_cursor, limit) reusing a single Telethon session across sources.
Telethon client operations: connect, get_entity, resolve channel id, iterate messages, stream-bounded media download.
Claim next leased window, checkpoint page with continuation cursor in the same tx as ingest, or fail with retry delay.
Delegates batch dedup/record into _process_batch inside the caller-owned SQLite transaction.
Phase 1 routing for source type v2ray_collector: wrap the Go scraper as a connector.
Subprocess 'go run main.go' in connectors/v2ray_collector with 300s timeout; output file consumed afterwards.
HTTP GET of public channel previews parsed with goquery (.tgme_widget_message) to extract config messages.
Yield each scraped config line as a text SourceItem with goscrap_ external id.
get_pending_files(limit=200) for each transform batch.
Load raw bytes by SHA-256 hash for parsing.
decide_format(filename, data) then handler.parse(data, source_info) into hashed records.
Atomic commit: add_records_batch with observation provenance + update_observation_status_batch in one transaction.
ZIP/opaque handlers (ovpn, npv4, ehi, hc, hat, sip, nm, dark, tut, sks, tmt, opaque_bundle) read stored raw blobs when building artifacts.
Governed build query: records joined to seen_files with DISTINCT fan-out dedup; verdict-gated by publication tier and fresh-probe policy.
handler.build(records) under a per-format lock; derive decoded.json/b64sub/singbox for npvt-family.
save_artifact (immutable internal copy) + save_output (atomic user-facing output, archive on change).
Orchestrator export stage writes outputs/ and outputs_dev/ from all_build_results (partial export honored when timed out).
Ensure publication intent, mark sending/confirmed/failed/unknown_outcome, complete intent, mark published_artifacts.
Publisher picked per token with a shared lock; errors classified against the delivery ledger.
POST /bot<token>/sendDocument with bounded retry on 429.
Age-based prune of seen_files/records/published_artifacts (legacy auto-prune and explicit `huntx prune`), protecting active blob references.
Cleanup stage: prune_processed + prune_orphans for raw blobs no longer referenced.
prune_archive(retention_days=4) after each run.
User registration, preferences, active-user queries, delivery checkpoints and delivered-item dedup.
Long-poll bot session: command events, inline callbacks, send_message/send_file with flood-wait handling.
/latest and /get fall back to list_archive(days) when outputs/ has no matching file.
Admin /admin run button triggers Orchestrator.run in an executor thread, then deliver_updates_active.
Auto-deliver scans data/outputs/ for npvt/b64sub files to approved unmuted users.
Own SQLite connection (default :memory:) recording failures, retest schedule and stale purges.
Every repository method opens a transactional connection through DBConnection.connect with WAL + FULL synchronous.
Campaign seeding, lease claiming (BEGIN IMMEDIATE), checkpoints, retry scheduling, expiry recovery.
Lifecycle events, verdict upserts and governed-build reads, bot consumer watermarks.
CI ingest-build-package runs `huntx --config configs/config.prod.yaml run` under a 105-minute watchdog with timeout signals.
verify-output + site-data for packaging; runtime-generation build/verify before checkpoint upload.
site-data regenerates docs/ from the verified data-dir outputs; replaced only when verification passes.
aws s3 sync/cp of generations/<id>/payload, manifest.json and atomic current.json pointer advance; restore path reads the same layout.
deploy-pages job publishes docs/ to GitHub Pages.
huntx-engine georoute mirrors the Python GeoRoutingEngine logic (InferCountryCode/FilterByRegion) in Go.
`huntx bot` subcommand starts the persistent InteractiveBot; `huntx run` auto-delivery reuses deliver_updates after the pipeline.
Next-gen orchestrator composes geo routing, scoring, self-healing and streaming parser at construction.
CI builds cmd/huntx-engine as part of the Go release plane (gofmt/go test/go vet/go build).
Release manifest indexes output artifacts for publish/verify flows.
checkpoint_runtime_state.py copies the live SQLite db (WAL checkpoint) and inventories raw blobs for the immutable generation payload.
report_runtime_health.py reads persist/data/logs/run-summary.json, evaluates the disposition and appends a GitHub step summary; the job enforces only truly fatal outcomes.
huntx-tools release-manifest builds and verifies the file manifest used for distributable output (Go twin of store/release_manifest.py).
InteractiveBot owns a direct DBConnection: _init_tables creates bot tables, and registration/preference/stat queries run on raw connections in addition to StateRepo access.

flows.name: CLI bootstrap & health-gated pipeline run
flows.description: The production entry path: `huntx run` loads config, takes locks, drives the optimized orchestrator through all phases, then evaluates the run-health gate before auto-delivering via the bot.

steps.action: Create OptimizedHardenedOrchestrator, wire GovernedBuildPipeline + consumer reconciliation, then run with deadline
Auto-deliver outputs to approved users unless --no-auto-deliver

flows.name: MTProto newest-window-first (LIFO) ingestion
flows.description: Optimized ingestion for telegram_user sources: canonical channel dedup, seed a rolling horizon of closed epoch windows into the SQLite work queue, then lease pages newest-first with reused Telethon sessions until the budget is exhausted.

steps.action: Workers claim newest-incomplete window via claim_next with uuid lease
fetch_window_page under an exclusive session lock (reuse connector by credential key)
Telethon iter_messages/iter_download over the [window_start, window_end) range

flows.name: Bot API durable-inbox ingestion
flows.description: Legacy path for `telegram` sources: getUpdates are staged into telegram_bot_updates before offset acknowledgement, filtered by chat/freshness/type, then recorded as seen files with blobs saved.

steps.action: getUpdates offset=N+1 / timeout=2; getFile + bounded download for documents
store_bot_updates(fingerprint, updates) before next offset request
Save new content as SHA-256 blob per item

flows.name: V2Ray collector web-scrape ingestion
flows.description: Go scraper fetches public t.me/s previews for 49+ channels, tests proxy TCP reachability, dedupes and filters; the Python connector ingests collected_configs.txt lines.

flows.name: Transform pending observations into records
flows.description: Batched, thread-pooled parsing of pending seen_files into hashed records with atomic status flip and observation provenance.

flows.name: Governed route build & artifact export
flows.description: Per-route build in a thread pool: verdict-gated record fetch, format handler build, artifact persistence, and output/export derivation.

steps.action: save_artifact + save_output; derive decoded/b64sub/singbox for npvt

flows.name: Ledgered Telegram publication
flows.description: Publishes changed artifacts to destination chats while persisting per-destination delivery state; unknown outcomes are never auto-resent.

steps.action: mark sending; publisher.publish(chat_id, data, filename, caption)

flows.name: Auto-delivery to approved users
flows.description: After a run (or via the bot), sends new output files to approved, unmuted users with per-user dedup by artifact hash and resumable checkpoints.

steps.action: send_message + send_file with flood-wait retry, 0.3s pacing

flows.name: GatherX user session (register -> approve -> get)
flows.description: Interactive bot command handling: registration, admin approval, inline get/setfmt callbacks, /status aggregate queries.

steps.action: Start long-poll bot; register command menu and handlers
/status, /count aggregate stats via SQL CASE on data_json

flows.name: Admin-triggered in-process pipeline
flows.description: GatherX admin panel can trigger a pipeline run inside the bot process via executor thread, then deliver updates and report back.

steps.action: /admin run callback (admin check by numeric HUNTX_ADMINS)
_run_pipeline_blocking in executor (load config, acquire lock, Orchestrator.run)
deliver_updates_active + success/failure message to admin chat

flows.name: Cleanup & pruning cycle
flows.description: Post-run (and manual `huntx prune`/admin prune) removal of processed raw blobs, orphan blobs, old archives and age-based DB rows with blob-reference safety.

flows.name: CI production run (restore -> run -> persist -> deploy)
flows.description: GitHub Actions orchestrates state restore from S3, the huntx run under a watchdog, verified packaging + checkpoint, immutable S3 persistence, and GitHub Pages deploy; only fatal dispositions fail the job.

steps.action: restore-verified-state: validate pointer, sync generation payload
verify-output + site-data packaging (fallback to safety-net outputs)
persist-immutable-state: sync payload, verify manifest, advance current.json

flows.name: Site data generation (local + CI)
flows.description: Local scripts/generate_site_data.py or CI site-data regenerate docs/catalog.json and copy artifacts for the GatherX frontend.

steps.action: Generate() scans artifacts, writes catalog + copies files; ValidateCatalog gates promotion
Local equivalent: scripts/generate_site_data.py reads verified manifest and copies artifacts

flows.name: Durable Bot API inbox & crash-safe ack
flows.description: Telegram getUpdates responses are committed to telegram_bot_updates before the next offset request, so a crash between fetch and ack cannot lose updates; consumers reconcile watermarks.

steps.action: store_bot_updates(token_fingerprint, updates) BEFORE requesting next offset
read back durable updates after local offset; filter chat/media/apk/size; yield items
reconcile telegram_bot_consumers watermarks against configured tokens (consumer_reconciliation)

flows.name: Schema migration & VMess canonicalization
flows.description: On DB open, versioned migrations (user_version 1..10) add columns/tables and re-key legacy VMess records to the sorted-key canonical form; migration safety hardens postconditions.

steps.action: _check_migrations: PRAGMA user_version gate, ALTER/CREATE per version with postcondition checks
v10: canonicalize legacy vmess:// records (sort_keys JSON), migrate record_verdicts, purge orphans
install_migration_safety wraps _check_migrations with stale-hash cleanup and table guards

flows.name: S3 generation restore & verification
flows.description: CI restore-verified-state reads current.json, resolves the generation, syncs the payload, and verifies the manifest before the pipeline runs — stateless when S3_BUCKET is unset.

steps.action: aws s3 cp current.json; if absent -> fresh generation
